text:
If you were waiting for the sunny start, Burlington is running late: it’s 61 under mostly cloudy skies around midday, not the bright, quick warm-up advertised. The clouds should give way to some afternoon sun, with a high near 71 and a northwest breeze filling in. The official call stays dry, though the European model is the wetter outlier today, so I’d keep a light layer handy but wouldn’t change plans for rain. Skies clear tonight, with a low around 52 and a calm lake, water still a comfortable 68.

Saturday looks like the better outdoor day, sunny and warming to about 77, though south winds build noticeably by afternoon and the lake gets choppier. A shower may sneak in late Saturday night, after 11, but most of the evening should stay dry. Enjoy the waterfront through today’s late afternoon and Saturday morning, then plan for more wind on the lake Saturday afternoon.
